Studio.title: The studio
Studio.description: Innova Design is a small studio. We work on identity, digital product, and visual systems from Puebla.

blocks.title: What we do
blocks.body: We take a problem of form — a brand that does not hold, an interface that does not read, a system no one can follow — and leave it usable. The result is a direction and the pieces to apply it.

blocks.title: How we decide
blocks.body: We prefer a few well-argued options. Color, type, and space have a job. If an element does not order, inform, or stay maintainable, it stays out.

blocks.title: Where
blocks.body: The studio is in Puebla, Mexico. Projects can be local or remote. The first contact is by email.
